name: Falling Stars
source:
Dreams are but fragile things, and you have but one - to work with the big shots of the entertainment industry.
Thankfully, luck is on your side. 

Today you embark on your journey as the wardrobe assistant to none other than Michee, one of the most beloved idols of this generation. Together, you experience the trials of fame, fans, and even love. While uncovering the horrors behind the curtain, will you save the one you love?

Will you manage to catch your falling star?
